summary: At artifact digest 2c189ad0a6c54769e0f5c3904757a4a14a46add1a1e021e9327a9ff3ab733511, SC-001 through SC-006 have meaningful, bounded planned evidence. The existing Playwright projects will collect the proposed desktop and mobile tests; the Compose plan derives and injects the per-run trusted origin and provisions and reads back account exposure. The artifacts explicitly require independent-process, restart, termination, and parent-directory-fsync ordering evidence; cross-process prompt-free native-store checks; five native executable jobs; installer failure preservation; and published Unix/Windows installer evidence bound to the exact reviewed SHA. Existing coverage floors and Allure enforcement remain unchanged. One concrete CI traceability gap remains. No native execution, shell-adapter execution, or verified provenance is claimed; campaign provenance remains correlated and unverified.

findings.description: The plan extends the requirement-coverage scanner to recognize Rust tests, but it never explicitly wires a full feature-023 coverage invocation into the authoritative check-specs target. Following the tasks literally can therefore leave all 023-FR/SC markers unenforced while make verify-all and Full CI remain green.
evidence: scripts/check_requirement_coverage.py:71-84 currently scans no cli/tests tree and accepts no .rs suffix; tasks.md:11 correctly plans to extend this scanner.
Makefile:150-160 runs full requirement coverage only for specs/019-miro-like-crt-canvas; there is no invocation for specs/023-agent-cli.
tasks.md:11 mentions extending the scanner and updating gate hashes, but does not require adding `python3 scripts/check_requirement_coverage.py specs/023-agent-cli` to check-specs.
tasks.md:58 relies on make verify-all and general spec/gate checks for final evidence, while Makefile:171 defines verify-all through the presently incomplete check-specs target.
findings.recommendation: Amend T002 and plan.md to require three linked changes: scan cli/tests as a dedicated test tree with .rs support, add unit tests for that behavior, and add an unfiltered `python3 scripts/check_requirement_coverage.py specs/023-agent-cli` invocation to Makefile check-specs. Pin that invocation with the corresponding gate-integrity invariant/test and regenerate the manifest. Keep the existing coverage floors and Allure rules unchanged.
